caseName: Alfred Dunhill of London, Inc. v. Republic of Cuba
caseNameFull: Alfred Dunhill of London, Inc. v. Republic of Cuba

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 416 U. S. 981.] Case restored to calendar for reargument. In addition to other questions presented by this case, counsel are requested to brief and discuss during oral argument: Should this Court’s holding in Banco Nacional de Cuba v. Sabbatino, 376 U. S. 398 (1964), be reconsidered?
